issue.message: The lambda argument (`{ it <= ' ' }`) is unnecessary
issue.explanation:
The Kotlin standard library `trim()` call takes an optional lambda to specify which characters are considered whitespace.
When converting Java code to Kotlin code, the converter will convert calls for Java's `s.trim()` into `s.trim() { it <= ' ' }`. This preserves the exact semantics of the Java code, but is likely not what you want: the default in Kotlin uses a better definition of what constitutes a whitespace character (`Char::isWhitespace`) and also results in less bytecode at the call-site.
issue.errorLine1: private fun currentProcessName(): String? = runCatching { File("/proc/self/cmdline").readText().trim { it <= ' ' } }.getOrNull()

issue.message: Calling this method indicates use of dynamic shortcuts, but there are no calls to methods that track shortcut usage, such as `pushDynamicShortcut` or `reportShortcutUsed`. Calling these methods is recommended, as they track shortcut usage and allow launchers to adjust which shortcuts appear based on activation history. Please see https://developer.android.com/develop/ui/views/launch/shortcuts/managing-shortcuts#track-usage
issue.explanation: Reporting shortcut usage is important to improving the ranking of shortcuts
